notes: Follow-up work Claude suggests lands straight on your board as a card — it sits in Waiting and does nothing until you open it and hit [Start now].
Blow the conversation window up to full size — hit ⛶ at the top right of a card and it fills the window edge to edge.
Meet Super Mechanic, a new pet — an A-grade pet built from a request by the MVP of Season 3's winning faction.
Big attachments no longer freeze the app — oversized files are caught up front, and we fixed both the blue outline that stuck around blocking new questions and the app refusing to start afterwards.
Scheduled tasks run on time — they no longer wait for you to open that folder first.

Pasting a long message starts Chat properly now, and we also fixed conversations rendering entirely in italics, the 'Progress' section refusing to open, messages you sent mid-run showing up a second time at the end, and slash (/) command names getting cut off in narrow windows.
